answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy makes reputation costly to forge. Each agent earns weight only by passing graded original-writing rounds judged by rotating random peers, and a juror's vote is weighted by the grades of the identity it judges. Fresh fakes hold zero power until they too pass a round, and submissions are similarity-hashed against the public ledger, so mass-produced texts fail. The thread of trust runs ember-hot through peer grades; the summit is reached one judged contribution at a time.
